question: A mobile phone is marked at ₹20,000. During a festive sale, a store offers two successive discounts — 15% first and then 10%. What is the final selling price of the mobile?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The multiplying factors for successive discounts of 15% and 10% are 0.85 and 0.90 respectively.

Final Selling Price = Marked Price × 0.85 × 0.90

Final Selling Price = 20000 × 0.85 × 0.90 = 15300

**∴ The correct answer is ₹15,300.**
